mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows Alloy to create a Task without a created_by field and a TaskDeletion without a deleted_by field, violating the invariant that every task and deletion must be attributed to an authenticated member (FR-001).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthViolation { some t: Task | no t.created_by }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows Alloy to create two distinct TaskDeletion records with the same deleted_task_id, violating the append-only constraint that each deletion is unique and immutable (FR-012, FR-018).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendViolation { some disj td1, td2: TaskDeletion | td1.deleted_task_id = td2.deleted_task_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows Alloy to create a Task assigned to a non-member, violating the invariant that assignees must be current members of the workspace (FR-008).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AssigneeViolation { some t: Task | t.assignee not in Member and some t.assignee }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows Alloy to create a Task with an invalid status value outside the set {todo, in_progress, done}, violating the enum constraint on task status (FR-010).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_StatusViolation { some t: Task | t.status not in (TodoStatus + InProgressStatus + DoneStatus) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows Alloy to create a TaskDeletion record without a deleted_by user or without a task title snapshot, violating the invariant that all deletions must be properly attributed and include the task state at deletion (FR-018).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some td: TaskDeletion | no td.deleted_by }
